name: Groq API
tagline: Ultra-fast LLM inference via OpenAI-compatible API
description: Groq provides high-speed inference for open-source and proprietary large language models through an OpenAI-compatible REST API. Developers use documented Chat Completions, Responses, audio (speech-to-text/text-to-speech), models, batch, and file APIs, plus related endpoints; available model IDs change and should be taken from GET /openai/v1/models or the console models list (e.g. Llama and other currently listed models). Authentication uses a Bearer API key; free and paid tiers include rate limits that vary by model and plan.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header; create keys in Groq Console after free signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free tier with rate limits that vary by model (e.g. requests/min and tokens/min); exact free allowances change — check console rate-limits docs
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go per million tokens by model; higher rate limits on Developer/Enterprise plans

rate_limits: Per-model RPM/TPM/RPD limits; free tier lower, paid higher — see console rate limits page
use_cases: run fast chat completions with open LLMs
stream low-latency LLM responses for agents
call tools/functions via OpenAI-compatible chat API
batch or high-throughput inference with rate-limited free tier
swap OpenAI client base URL to Groq for cheaper/faster models
